purpose: Classify every top-level Markdown document under docs/ so no loose or ambiguous handoff/plan file can silently become project authority.
rule: Every docs/*.md file must appear exactly once here. Only category=authority files may define cross-project operating precedence. Current work starts at docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json.note: Development-only real-human source identities, permitted conclusions and uncertainty for anatomical deformation review; never production media or geometry-copy authority.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_BODY_MASTER_PLAN.json.note: Machine-readable governing plan for whole-body human movement/anatomy progression; open Critical/High whole-body issues override historical phase readiness.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_BODY_COVERAGE_MATRIX.j.note: Whole-body region and movement-family proof matrix under the authoritative human-body master plan.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_BODY_STATUS.json.note: Generated concise whole-body status: current master stage, blockers, coverage and exact next sequence.

ORIGINAL_V1_HUMAN_MOVEMENT_SWEEP_PLAN.js.note: Deterministic audit sweeps for grip release, trunk flexion/extension/lateral bend/rotation, loaded hip hinge, hip ab/adduction and ankle plantarflexion.

ORIGINAL_V1_ANATOMICAL_COUPLING_MAP.json.note: Authoritative whole-body attachment/shared-tissue dependency map. Covers all master body regions and movement families; correctives may not hide invalid base ownership.

ORIGINAL_V1_ANATOMICAL_COUPLING_EVIDENCE.note: Candidate-specific template for proving weights-only and corrected anatomical coupling through outbound/intermediate/return motion.

ORIGINAL_V1_JOINT_TISSUE_TRIGGER_MAP.jso.note: Maps material motion of rig bone/joint families to every connected tissue/coupling system that must be reviewed.

ORIGINAL_V1_COUPLING_ZONE_DECLARATION_TE.note: Candidate-specific pre-edit declaration for proximal/bridge/distal shared-tissue zones, protected neighbours, allowed operations/bones, hashes and required after-evidence.

ORIGINAL_V1_SURFACE_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_REQU.note: Requires real-human exterior surface evidence for all 12 body regions; biomechanics alone cannot close skin/muscle appearance.

POSE_COUPLING_SCOPE_OUTPUT.note: Candidate-bound read-only pose evidence mapping every materially moved rig joint/bone family to all connected anatomical coupling systems that must be reviewed.

ORIGINAL_V1_FIRST_PARTY_DEFORMATION_ARCH.note: Authoritative generic deformation stack: canonical kinematics, evidence-selected base skinning, multi-anchor coupling, joint-state pose-space correction, contact response, optional secondary dynamics. Exercise identity is forbidden as a deformation driver.

ORIGINAL_V1_MOVEMENT_COUPLING_EVIDENCE_T.note: Per-sample candidate evidence template; moved bones automatically trigger required connected tissue systems and COMPLETE is impossible when any triggered system is absent.

ORIGINAL_V1_ANATOMICAL_COUPLING_CAPTURE_.note: Candidate capture matrix for all 14 coupling systems, requiring weights-only and corrected layers plus intermediate/return motion and close landmarks.

motion_reversibility.note: Read-only Blender audit compares outbound versus return evaluated surfaces and shape-key states at identical joint-state fractions; detects residual/stateful deformation but does not by itself prove anatomy.

motion_continuity.note: Read-only dense-sample report separates weights-only and corrective contribution and identifies vertices with largest step/second-difference changes; report-only, not anatomical approval.

ORIGINAL_V1_DEFECT_COUPLING_MAP.json.note: Maps every current Critical/High whole-body issue to the anatomical coupling systems that must be candidate-proven before the issue may close.

skinning_mode.note: Read-only capture of the exact saved Blender Armature modifier skinning mode, including Preserve Volume/Dual Quaternion flag. Evidence only; does not authorize a global mode change.

coupling_weight_audit.note: Read-only candidate/declaration-bound diagnostic of proximal/distal anchor weight shares and ownership discontinuities inside a declared shared-tissue zone; numeric distribution is diagnostic, not anatomy acceptance.

ORIGINAL_V1_ANATOMICAL_REPAIR_PACKAGES.j.note: Practical repair packages for all 14 anatomical coupling systems: failure layers, protected anatomy, weights-only acceptance, residual corrective role and proof movements.

ORIGINAL_V1_DEFORMATION_DIAGNOSIS_TREE.j.note: Fail-closed diagnosis order from source/kinematics through skinning, weights, topology, correctives, contact, continuity, regression and human visual review.

ORIGINAL_V1_WEIGHTS_ONLY_ACCEPTANCE_CONT.note: Region-by-region weights-only anatomical acceptance criteria; corrective-free proof required before corrective refinement.

ORIGINAL_V1_POSE_MOVEMENT_FAMILY_MAP.jso.note: Maps validation pose fixtures to master movement families for evidence planning only; never runtime deformation logic.

POSE_CAPTURE_EVIDENCE_PLAN_OUTPUT.note: Automatically expands a pose-scope report into required tissue systems, cameras, landmarks, human references, layers and open evidence needs.

ORIGINAL_V1_CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_MANIFES.note: Unified parent-to-candidate comparison manifest spanning weights-only, coupling, motion, regression, contact, visual and issue closure evidence.

ORIGINAL_V1_STAGE1_REPAIR_EXECUTION_GRAP.note: Dependency-aware 8-wave Stage 1 sequence from global deformation semantics through connected shoulder, trunk, limbs and final whole-body integration.

ORIGINAL_V1_DEFORMATION_FAILURE_SIGNATUR.note: Visual failure signatures mapped to likely investigation layers and forbidden shortcuts; hypotheses only, never proof of cause.

PRE_REPAIR_DIAGNOSTIC_BUNDLE_OUTPUT.note: One-command read-only bundle: readiness, saved skinning mode, pose connected-tissue scope, automatic evidence plan, shoulder layer decomposition, reversibility and dense continuity with candidate SHA cross-checking.

REPAIR_REGRESSION_PLAN_OUTPUT.note: Automatically derives directly connected tissue systems, body regions, movements, cameras, landmarks and blockers for focused regression while preserving full whole-body regression.

BASE_SKINNING_AB_OUTPUT.note: Controlled read-only weights-only LBS vs Preserve Volume/DQ comparison; restores saved mode and explicitly forbids selecting a mode from numeric difference alone.

REPAIR_DECLARATION_DRAFT_OUTPUT.note: Auto-prefills candidate repair declaration from the selected anatomical package/coupling/defect/evidence authorities; actual vertex zones and allowed bone groups still require candidate-specific declaration.

ORIGINAL_V1_CANDIDATE_SURFACE_VISUAL_REV.note: Candidate-bound human exterior surface review requiring five motion states, whole-body context, regional close views and human evidence.

ORIGINAL_V1_REPAIR_EXECUTION_RECORD_TEMP.note: Post-edit provenance linking immutable pre-edit declaration to final candidate SHA and proving edits stayed inside declared vertices/bones/operations.

post_edit_evidence_bundle.note: After a repaired Blend has a final SHA, initializes candidate issue ledger, weights-only/coupling/movement/visual records, immutable declaration copies, execution drafts and unified comparison manifest in one candidate folder.

ORIGINAL_V1_STAGE1_PROGRESS.json.note: Fail-closed live Stage 1 progress ledger across 8 dependency waves and 14 repair packages; selects the next operational action without inferring anatomical clearance.
